@graph.headline: Otter vs Fireflies vs Fathom: A 2026 Guide for US Teams
@graph.description: Otter ai vs Fireflies ai vs Fathom in 2026: free plans, prices per seat, CRM sync, recording limits and privacy compared for US teams, with a clear verdict.

itemListElement.name: Otter vs Fireflies vs Fathom: A 2026 Guide for US Teams

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is better for live transcripts and individual use, while Fireflies is better for teams that want CRM sync, topic tracking and search across calls. Price is close. On annual billing it is $8.33 versus $10 a month, so run both on the same 3 meetings before deciding.

mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Fireflies or Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is cheaper on annual billing ($8.33 versus $10 for the entry plan). Monthly, Otter Pro costs $16.99 against $18 for Fireflies Pro. Only need recording? Then Fathom's free plan beats both on price, and for paid seats, annual billing saves the most.

mainEntity.name: Is Fathom better than Otter and Fireflies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fathom has the best free plan of the three, with unlimited recordings and transcripts. Fireflies goes deeper on integrations; Otter has live transcripts. For anyone who does not want to pay, Fathom is the best starting point. Need CRM sync later? Upgrade then.

Yes, Fireflies records video on its Business plan and above. Fathom records video even on its free plan, while Otter focuses on audio and transcripts. Sharing short clips with colleagues who missed a call is easy with Fathom's free video, something neither Otter nor Fireflies offers for free.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Otter, Fireflies or Fathom without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partly. Fireflies has a desktop app that records system audio without a bot, and Fathom offers bot-free capture in beta, but Otter relies on its meeting agent. Lynkk records bot-free through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Either way, tell attendees.

mainEntity.name: Which works best with Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: All three join Microsoft Teams meetings, each one as a participant in the call. Companies that prefer built-in tools should know Teams' own AI recap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Check your IT policy first.
